issuereport.description_required: Type a description or record a voice note.
issuereport.discard_confirm: Discard this report and everything attached to it?
issuereport.intro: Describe what happened by typing or recording a voice note (and optionally your screen), plus the till's recent logs. Saved on this till immediately — it's queued to upload once this shop is online.
issuereport.logs_note: The till's recent warning/error logs are attached automatically.
issuereport.my_reports.empty: No reports sent from this till yet. A report appears here as soon as you save it — whether or not it has uploaded yet.
issuereport.my_reports.intro: Reports from this till — sent or still waiting to send — with their last-known status. Statuses refresh automatically when the shop is online; a report that hasn't uploaded yet shows as pending.
issuereport.my_reports.more_not_shown: %d more report(s) not shown — check back once older ones are filed or discarded.
issuereport.my_reports.title: My reports
issuereport.note_placeholder: Describe what happened, e.g. which screen, what you tapped… (or use voice below)
issuereport.recording_across_pages: Recording keeps running while you move between pages. If the page fully reloads, what was captured so far is kept.
issuereport.recording_kept_after_reload: The page reloaded, so recording stopped — what was captured up to then is kept below.
issuereport.route_note: You can open the report panel from any screen with the 🐞 button in the top bar.
issuereport.save_error: Couldn't save the report — try again.
issuereport.saved: Saved. It will upload automatically once this shop is online.
issuereport.status.failing_reason.joined: This device is joined to the shop but still can't get its own cloud access from the main till. Check that the main till is on, online, registered with the cloud and up to date.
issuereport.status.failing_reason.not_re: This till isn't fully set up yet — finish enrolling it to send reports.
issuereport.status.failing_reason.other: Couldn't reach the cloud after several tries. It will keep retrying automatically.
issuereport.status.pending_reason.joined: This device is joined to the shop and is getting its own cloud access from the main till. The report sends by itself after that. Keep the main till on and online.
